record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Find necessary and sufficient order-theoretic conditions on a directed complete poset P for its Scott space Sigma P=(P, sigma(P)) to be well-filtered.

evidence.quote: Question 4.5. Find an order characterization for Scott well-filtered dcpos (cf. the first problem below [19, Exercise VII-1.14]).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(P,\leq)$ be a directed complete partially ordered set (dcpo); that is, every directed subset $D\subseteq P$ has a supremum $\bigvee D$ in $P$. A subset $U\subseteq P$ is Scott open if (i) $U$ is an upper set (i.e., $x\in U$ and $x\leq y$ imply $y\in U$) and (ii) for every directed subset $D$ with $\bigvee D\in U$, we have $D\cap U\neq\emptyset$. The collection $\sigma(P)$ of Scott open sets is a topology on $P$, and the Scott space is $\Sigma P=(P,\sigma(P))$.

A topological space $X$ is well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i:i\in I\}$ of compact saturated subsets of $X$ (saturated meaning equal to the intersection of its open neighborhoods) and every open set $U\subseteq X$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I}K_i\subseteq U$, there exists $i_0\in I$ with $K_{i_0}\subseteq U$.

Problem: Provide a purely order-theoretic necessary and sufficient condition on a dcpo $P$ for its Scott space $\Sigma P$ to be well-filtered.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of finding a purely order-theoretic characterization of dcpos whose Scott topology is well-filtered (analogous to the longstanding open problem of order-characterizing Scott-sober dcpos posed as Exercise VII-1.14 in the Gierz et al. continuous lattices book) appears still to be open. Recent works (2018–2025) study sufficient conditions and examples (e.g., constructions of dcpos with Scott topology well-filtered but not sober) but do not provide a full order-theoretic characterization.

status_evidence.title: A new dcpo whose Scott topology is well-filtered but not sober
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs examples separating well-filteredness from sobriety for Scott topologies on dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: Well-filtered and sober Scott topologies on dcpos are distinct, and order characterizations remain a research topic.

status_evidence.title: Posets Uniquely Determined by its Scott Compact Saturated Subsets
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) study of compact saturated subsets in Scott spaces, related to well-filteredness.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research suggests no complete order-theoretic characterization is yet established.

status_evidence.title: Commutation of Smyth and Hoare Power Constructions in Well-filtered Dcpos
status_evidence.snippet: Studies well-filtered dcpos and properties of their Scott topologies.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing work on well-filtered dcpos indicates the order characterization problem remains open.
